items.description: Fighting between Iran-backed Houthi rebels and Yemeni government forces has intensified around the city of Taiz. Residents face growing shortages of food, water and medical supplies as thousands flee their homes.

items.title: Air raid alerts and attacks on schools: the devastating face of education in Ukraine
items.description: Ukraine has sustained almost 2,000 attacks on education since the full-scale Russian invasion in 2022, with some 270 this year alone, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Tuesday, a day after a strike at a school being used to distribute aid.

items.title: Ukrainian Crowd Clashes With Riot Police, Again Highlighting Recruitment Tactics, Military Morale
items.description: A crowd clashed with police and National Guard troops in a Kyiv suburb amid allegations that men were being held and tortured in a private house. The incident highlights growing tensions over Ukraine’s controversial military recruitment practices as it strives to repel Russia’s full-scale invasion.

items.title: In Poland, the 'Coalition of the Willing' holds first large-scale military exercise
items.description: The Koalicja exercise is set to take place in Nowa Deba, in southeastern Poland, from November 9 to 22. Nearly 2,800 soldiers, mostly French, are expected to be deployed to test the alliance's ability to mobilize in the event of a ceasefire in Ukraine.
